name: Legacy Orbital Port
description: A synthetic orbital calculation ported from Fortran to Rust and C++, checked against reference outputs.
scope: Educational numerical parity, not an operational flight-dynamics system or a measured performance claim.
proof: Reference-output comparison and automated regression checks are included in the repository.

name: Agent Runtime Lab
description: A reproducible lab for profiling Python runtime behavior and comparing a bounded optimization against its baseline.
scope: A local teaching implementation. Results apply to the included workload, not Google's ADK production runtime.
proof: The repository records the baseline, optimized implementation, regression checks and benchmark procedure.

name: Spatial Electronics Lab
description: An interactive electronics scene with a browser companion and an Android APK built from source.
scope: The APK was built. Physical Android-device testing has not been established.
proof: Release assets include the Android APK. Source, build instructions and browser screenshots are available.

name: Desk Circuit Racer
description: A playable desk-themed racing prototype that turns a synthetic desk layout into a browser circuit.
scope: Uses a synthetic desk plan. It does not reconstruct a real desk from photographs.
proof: The repository includes the playable browser build, automated checks and desktop/mobile screenshots.

name: Parametric Pavilion
description: A parameter-driven pavilion workflow connecting Blender source, rendered views, GLB export and a browser viewer.
scope: Procedural digital geometry and rendered evidence. No structural engineering or construction claim.
proof: Blender 5.0.1 produced the .blend file, GLB and rendered images. Reproduction instructions accompany the release.

name: WebGPU Cable Lab
description: A browser cable/strand simulation with WebGPU compute and a CPU reference for checking numerical behavior.
scope: A simulation prototype. No general FPS, physical material-validation or device-compatibility claim.
proof: A 16,384-strand run was checked in Brave with actual GPU execution and CPU-reference parity evidence.

name: Body Data Viewer
description: A viewer that maps a synthetic body-composition report into seven disjoint regions, with text, PDF and JSON ingestion.
scope: Synthetic teaching data only. Not a diagnostic tool, medical-device validation or patient-data study.
proof: 36 automated tests cover report ingestion and validation. Screenshots demonstrate the region and metric views.

name: Cislunar OEM Replay
description: A browser replay of synthetic OEM/CSV trajectories with Earth/Moon context and continuous Earth-boundary checks.
scope: Synthetic teaching trajectories, not NASA mission telemetry. Moon checks are node-based, not continuous lunar-safety proof.
proof: 45 tests include continuous Hermite-curve checks against the Earth boundary, including collisions between sample nodes.

name: Sensor Enclosure CAD
description: A parameter-driven sensor enclosure with OpenSCAD source, STL exports and section/exploded browser views.
scope: Digital geometry checks only. No physical printing, mechanical-strength or manufacturing-fit validation.
proof: 47 tests and actual OpenSCAD/STL generation support the release. The example uses 2.4 mm walls.

name: Motion Rally
description: A two-controller browser tennis prototype with WebSocket pairing, validated sensor messages and touch controls.
scope: Two browser controllers and touch fallback were checked. Physical-phone motion, Wi-Fi latency and live TTS remain unverified.
proof: 28 Node tests cover the protocol and guards. Browser checks exercised two controllers and a narrow mobile viewport.

name: Run Ledger
description: A local ledger for agent-run costs, human review and evidence, with currency-aware Decimal aggregation and metadata redaction.
scope: Costs depend on supplied inputs. Unknown costs remain unknown. A hash chain is not external attestation.
proof: 19 tests cover mixed currencies, aggregation before rounding, nested redaction and atomic imports.

name: Bounded Refactor
description: A bounded refactoring harness that freezes tests and source snapshots, checks public signatures and exports reviewable diffs.
scope: A trusted-local verification tool, not a security sandbox. Detached-child containment has documented Windows limitations.
proof: 28 tests cover paths and aliases, frozen tests, public signatures, output boundaries and timeout behavior.

name: FIR Parity
description: A synthetic FIR-filter parity lab comparing real Fortran and Rust binaries against an independent Python reference.
scope: Numerical parity for the included cases, not a performance speedup or hardware signal-validation claim.
proof: 26 tests run with actual compilers. Windows and Linux CI cover signed randomized inputs and finite/count/work bounds.
